name: hud_duel_wave_list_shows_the_surge
description: A duel's waves to come go on into the Surge from the first window (playtest halv s1, f136736: 'Wave 12/12 · next in 8 s' and hovering showed 'Waves to come' empty; 'Nobody told me about a Surge'). On Undertow's own rules against the caretaker, before wave 1 the list holds the twelve waves, then the Surge's line ('The Surge, if both Holdfasts stand after wave 12: health +35%', from the rules' hp_pm), then S1 to S3, each with the checks and creeps of the wave it repeats and 'wave 9 again' at its end. With both hollows moved on so the next horn plays wave 12, my hollow clears it first while the rival's still plays it: the list then holds S1 to S3 under the same line (it stood empty there before), and the strip's next glyphs are S1's, wave 9's.

steps.assert: node('WaveList').visible and node('WaveRow12') != null and node('WaveRow13') != null and node('WaveRow15') != null
steps.msg: from the first window the list goes past wave 12 into the Surge

steps.assert: node('SurgeHead').text == 'The Surge, if both Holdfasts stand after wave 12: health +35%' and node('WaveRows').get_child_count() == 16
steps.msg: twelve waves, the Surge's line, its three waves

steps.assert: node('Hud').wave_list_lines()[12] == 'The Surge, if both Holdfasts stand after wave 12: health +35%' and node('Hud').wave_list_lines()[13] == 'S1: swift armored | scuttler ×16 · 65 hp, thornback ×5 · 324 hp · armour 4 · wave 9 again' and node('Hud').wave_list_lines()[15].begins_with('S3: ') and node('Hud').wave_list_lines()[15].ends_with(' · wave 11 again')
steps.msg: S1 holds wave 9's checks and creeps and says so; S3 is wave 11 again
both hollows moved on in the first window: the next horn plays wave 12

steps.assert: Game.state == Game.State.PREP and Game.wave == 12 and Game.duel_wave() and Game.sim.hollows[1].phase == 1
steps.msg: my hollow cleared wave 12; the rival's still plays it
the strip's next glyphs are S1's: wave 9's

steps.assert: node('WaveList').visible and node('WaveRows').get_child_count() == 4 and node('WaveRow12') == null and node('WaveRow13').get_child(0).text == 'S1'
steps.msg: the list is not empty: the Surge's line and its three waves

steps.assert: node('SurgeHead').text == 'The Surge, if both Holdfasts stand after wave 12: health +35%'
steps.msg: still if both stand: the rival's wave 12 is not over
